description: Deterministic maze generation: seeded grid mazes, geometry, curved walls, and multi-layer mazes with a solvability proof.
rules: A maze is a pure function of its dimensions and seed; never call Math.random.
Treat any change to the order or number of random draws as breaking, because it changes every stored seed.
Use assertSolvable on layered mazes; it reports a SolvabilityReport rather than throwing.
Dimensions are forced odd so the maze has a single centre cell.
